The '''Seer of the Temple''', or the '''Swamp Seer''', was a [[Unidentified Gap Nine species|native]] of [[Gap Nine]]. The Seer resided in an ancient [[Gap Nine temple|temple]], serving as a guardian of its treasures. The Seer was hostile towards the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], because [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Icus Traft]]&mdash;who ran the Imperial activities on the planet&mdash;had been looting several temples for ancient artifacts.

The Seer received unexpected help from a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operatives, who were on a [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] [[Mission to Gap Nine|mission]]. The Rebels helped the Seer defend his temple when Traft and his men tried to raid it.
